units.source: MJCF metres; mesh numeric coordinates metres; angles radian

coordinateMap: B:[x,z,-y]; source body node B*M*B^-1; geometry B*geomTransform*meshScale; source quaternions normalized per MJCF convention
identity: part_id is mjcf:<original body name>; direct original source hierarchy. Visual occurrence IDs derive from body-local original geom index, separate from mesh definitions.
limitations: MJCF body identities and hierarchy are source-backed, but visual meshes merge physical hardware; there is no per-screw identity, native STEP assembly, B-rep or manufacturing topology.
Head and rubber hand visuals belong to existing torso/wrist bodies in this source. They are not additional articulated joints.
Exploded separation is an editorial display operation, not collision-checked service disassembly.
Source joint axes, limits, inertials and actuator declarations are retained as source evidence; no dynamics, balance, contact or control validation is claimed.
